reviews.title: Been feeding the to my dogs for a leg time
reviews.body: Been feeding my dogs nature variety prairie for years so I was glad to see that they just repackaged it rather than take it off the shelf. Dogs seem to like it and the kibble share small enough for my 4.5 pounder. Not sure if I'll order again since natures variety was listed as one of the brands that contains ingredients that cause heart disease in some dogs.
